lane: Wayback CDX sweep for a contemporaneous DAI/PSM-USDC balance source
target: a contemporaneous public source for the MakerDAO PSM's USDC balance on/about 11 March 2023 (window 2023-03-09..2023-03-13), to replace the Jan-2023 ~$2.4B figure currently cited as PSMSOURCE in paper/fc27/fc27.tex Appendix B

queries.result: FAILED -- daistats.com is a client-side React SPA that fetches its numbers live (web3/JSON-RPC calls the Wayback crawler does not execute). Only the static HTML shell, favicon, robots.txt and two JS bundles were captured (nearest-in-window snapshot 20230313204526); the shell contains no numeric data, confirmed by fetching and inspecting it directly (id_ raw capture).

FAILED -- same SPA problem as daistats.com. A snapshot exists at 20230311135351 (11 March itself) but only captures the static HTML shell (root/favicon/robots.txt/JS/CSS bundles); no embedded data, confirmed by fetching and inspecting it directly (id_ raw capture).
125 URLs returned; filtered for usdc/psm/svb/circle/depeg/peg keywords -> 5 candidate threads. Fetched and read the two most relevant in full:

threads_fetched.result: Governance thread proposing an emergency PSM debt-ceiling breaker; discusses the mechanism, not a USDC balance figure. No dollar amount for the PSM found.
Community-call thread asking Circle to freeze $50M; unrelated dollar figures only (a $558M Nomad bridge class-action mention). No PSM balance figure found.

queries.result: FAILED -- 14 URLs returned, all generic historical blog posts unrelated to the SVB/USDC episode (a background recrawl, not a crisis-specific post). No SVB/PSM/USDC crisis post exists on this domain in the window.

SUCCESS -- 45 URLs returned. Two MakerDAO/SVB-dated articles found: post/219039 'MakerDAO launches emergency proposal to limit USDC exposure' (11 Mar 2023 11:17AM EST; fetched and read in full -- discusses the emergency governance proposal and quotes a MakerDAO tweet on total collateralization ($8.26B collateral / 5.38B DAI, a different, non-PSM figure) but gives no PSM-USDC balance) and post/218993 'USDC remains at about $0.90 following Circle's disclosure of funds at SVB' (11 Mar 2023 05:10AM EST) -- THIS ONE contains the target figure, see psm_source_20230311.json.

20 URLs returned; most relevant by title, 'Coinbase Looking To Acquire $1.6B of MakerDAO's USDC', was fetched and read in full but its byline/datePublished is 2022-09-07 -- an old article merely re-crawled in the March 2023 window, not a contemporaneous SVB-period source. Discarded. No other MakerDAO/DAI article in this domain's March-2023 crawl mentions a PSM balance.

FAILED to return -- CDX query for this very large domain filter-regex over its full crawl exceeded server-side time budget (504 Gateway Time-out from web.archive.org). Not retried once the theblock.co source below was confirmed sufficient and on-target.

successful_source.fetch_note: Wayback served this with Content-Encoding: gzip; fetched with curl --compressed to decode it. Decoded HTML's <title>/og:title/datePublished match the target article (not a redirect/placeholder).
